rules.text: Use https://api.nixflex.com/v1 for customer integrations. Keep the API credential on your server.
rules.why: The credential grants access to the owning account.

rules.text: No self-service sandbox account or URL exists.
rules.instead: Use fixtures locally or an owned test number for real traffic. Use another environment only when Nixflex provisions it.
rules.why: Staging exists for internal testing only.

rules.text: Use your server to identify the customer and authorise each operation before calling Nixflex. A shared account credential can see multiple customers.
Rotate the secret during a coordinated cutover. Update callers holding the old secret immediately.
The default allowance is [[acc-rate]] requests per minute. Observe the effective limit returned by the API.
Create a credential on a trusted server or rotate the current secret. Never give a new secret to an AI assistant.
On rate_limit_exceeded wait for the indicated retry interval before the next eligible request.
